title: Batch 1 local synthetic checkout services added
summary: Added fail-closed staging-only synthetic quote, order and side-effect services with local tests; hosted configuration remains unconfigured and the build correctly rejected missing environment isolation.

changes.detail: Added staging-only synthetic free/paid/failed/timeout quotes, COD and PayPal order simulations, and no-send email/SMS/inventory responses.
Added fail-closed tests requiring APP_ENV=staging, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=staging and STAGING_SYNTHETIC_ENABLED=true.
